svg.text: Relational Database Overhaul • Third Normal Form (3NF) Architecture • Author: Gerald Martadinata • © 2026

g.text: • Primary residence via majority purchase history
• Locks billed price at sale time (Preserves 3NF)
• Clean modal descriptions & standard reference prices
• Decrements on sale (+qty), increments on return (-qty)

3NF Compliance: All transitive and partial functional dependencies eliminated. Live catalog prices stored in PRODUCT; historical sale prices locked in INVOICE_LINE. Customer order dates calculated dynamically via View view_customer_rfm.
